p: spake unto all Israel: That is, he proclaimed a solemn sacrifice and commanded that all should attend.
of the congregation of God: So called, because by it God showed signs of his presence to the congregation.
brasen altar: Which was for the burnt offerings, Ex 27:1.
established: Perform your promise made to my father concerning me.
go out and come in before: That I may govern this people, 1Ch 27:1, 1Ki 3:7.
life of thine enemies: That is, to be avenged on your enemies.
chariot cities: Which were cities appointed to keep and maintain the chariots.
stones: He caused so great plenty that it was valued no more than stones.
the king's merchants received the linen: Read 1Ki 20:28.
